description: An open coloring book with two seahorses is in front, with a box of crayons set just above the page on the bed. The left hand rests on and steadies the page as a left-hand object, while the right hand holds a yellow crayon as a right-hand object and makes short back-and-forth strokes to fill sections of the uncolored seahorse, occasionally lifting slightly and repositioning to continue coloring along the outlined body and fin.
